page_summary: This page presents Figure 14, which illustrates the prevalence of specialized training or professional development opportunities for cybersecurity personnel in ports across different income levels. It categorizes responses into four groups: 'Yes, at least once a year,' 'Yes, but less than once a year,' 'No, no formal training is provided,' and 'Prefer not to say.' Additionally, Box 9 discusses case studies from the University of Plymouth and the Stevens Institute of Technology, highlighting collaborations aimed at improving cybersecurity capacity in maritime contexts.

regions.label: Figure 14
regions.description: Bar chart showing the percentage of responses regarding specialized training for cybersecurity personnel in ports, categorized by income level (Low income, Lower-middle income, Upper-middle income, High income). The responses are divided into four categories: 'Yes, at least once a year,' 'Yes, but less than once a year,' 'No, no formal training is provided,' and 'Prefer not to say.'
